title: Customer Service Executive
description: Customer Service Executive, Billingham Salary: From 27,000 depending on experience I'm delighted to be recruiting on behalf of my client for a Customer Service Executive to join their growing team in Billingham. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with customer service or administration experience who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and delivering outstanding service. You'll become the first point of contact for customers, managing enquiries, processing orders, and ensuring every interaction is handled efficiently and professionally. If you're organised, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this could be a fantastic next step in your career. Key responsibilities: As a key member of the customer service team, you will: - Manage customer enquiries via phone and email - Process sales orders accurately and efficiently - Maintain and update customer records and order information - Handle returns, credits, invoices, and proof of delivery requests - Keep customers informed of order progress, delivery dates, and any delays - Resolve customer issues promptly and professionally - Produce reports and maintain spreadsheets to ensure accuracy - Support the wider team with administrative and customer service activities - Work towards individual and team performance targets Criteria: - Previous experience within a customer service, sales support, or administration role - Excellent communication skills with a professional telephone manner - Strong organisational skills and attention to detail - Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office - The ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively under pressure - A proactive and positive approach to problem-solving If you're an honest, passionate, resilient customer-focused professional looking for your next challenge, I'd love to hear from you!

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: CUSTOMER SERVICE ADVISOR NEWCASTLE UNDER LYME - £26,500 - £30,000 PLUS COMMISSION Are you a dynamic and enthusiastic individual with a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences while driving sales? Join our clients vibrant team as a Customer Service and Sales Agent, where your fun and motivated spirit will help push the boundaries of customer service and sales excellence! Confidence is key and you will be dealing with customers very quickly, although ongoing training and support will continue. COMPANY BACKGROUND Our client is an independent company that works on a national basis. They offer a market leading customer service experience. Great customer service is at the heart of the business. They have continued to grow month on month and gain a reputation for offering a competitive service and second to none customer service. This is a small business and every single employee is a member of the family, as are the customers. CUSTOMER SERVICE JOB PURPOSE Develop a culture of customer satisfaction through timely and thorough handling of complaints, queries and general enquiries. Working in a fast-paced environment, to address customer issues via the telephone or email. CUSTOMER SERVICE DUTIES - Deliver Exceptional Service: Engage with customers in a friendly and upbeat manner, providing them with incredible support and assistance. - Sales Dynamo: Harness your customer service and communication skills to promote and sell our products and services. Achieve and exceed targets by empathising with customer needs and providing tailored solutions. NO COLD CALLING - Motivated Team Player: Collaborate with fellow team members to sales brainstorm creative ideas and strategies that elevate our service and sales game. - Innovate & Progress: Take the initiative to learn new things and provide suggestions for assisting the business growth. - Feedback Champion: Embrace feedback enthusiastically, using it as a tool for growth. CUSTOMER SERVICE REQUIREMENTS - Excellent communication skills - Customer focused - Self-motivated - Able to manage complaints professionally - Keen to drive business forward - Ideally experienced dealing with customers on the telephone - Passionate about helping people - Team player - Able to work in a fast-paced environment - Excellent PC skills - Problem solver - Patient - Able to work under pressure - Due to location, it is preferred you have you own transport PACKAGE AND BENEFITS - Working 2 shifts Monday to Friday 9am-5.30pm and 9.30am-6pm - Working 1 Saturday per month 9am-3pm - 20 days holiday plus Bank Holidays - Onsite Parking - £26,500 - £30,000 plus commission - Fantastic opportunity to build a career - Excellent ongoing training and support - Fun days and events - Feel valued everyday Follow us on twitter In respect to the above role(s), Anderson Wright Consulting Ltd operates as an Employment Agency CUSTOMER SERVICE ADVISOR NEWCASTLE UNDER LYME - £26,500 - £30,000 PLUS COMMISSION

title: Customer Service Assistant
description: Customer Service Assistant, Newcastle under Lyme, Permanent, £29,000 Are you looking for a new challenge, within a business that will support your growth and reward your hard work? We are looking for an experienced Customer Service candidate to become a pivotal member of my clients Client Services team. Joining a small team of 3, you will be the face of this successful and thriving business, ensuring that quality service is always delivered. If you have a professional manner, a business savvy approach and a desire to deliver first class service, then we want to hear from you. Daily duties will include - Acting as the face of the business - Providing a first-class customer service over the telephone, via email and on live chat - Responding to all Trustpilot reviews online in a professional and helpful manner - Redirecting calls where appropriate and taking messages for the wider team - Responding to all written communication professionally, via email or letter - Provide administration support to the wider business including the Sales and Account Manager s when required - Resolving and investigating any complaints made by customers - Keeping accurate records and updating the inhouse system This role is ideal for someone who has worked within customer service previously and enjoys being the go-to person for all customer queries. Our client would welcome applications from candidates who have worked in a similar position previously. They are seeking someone friendly, with a naturally helpful manner, who is driven, self-motived and well organised. Due to the nature of the business, the successful candidate will be required to undertake a DBS check before commencing work. In return they offer excellent company benefits such as enhanced holidays, pension scheme, private health care plus more. Beautiful modern offices. An opportunity not to be missed. For more information regarding the above role, please call Nicola on (phone number removed) or forward your CV. Please note that due to the high volume of applications we receive, only those successfully shortlisted for the role will be personally contacted. Follow us on LinkedIn for updates, recruitment information, new vacancies and more!

title: Customer Service Agent
description: Nigel Wright are delighted to be supporting a growing and customer-focused organisation in the recruitment of a Customer Service Agent. This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team environment where delivering outstanding customer experiences is at the heart of everything they do. The Opportunity As a Customer Service Agent, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, helping to resolve enquiries, provide information and ensure a positive experience across multiple communication channels. You'll play a key role within a busy Customer Operations team, taking ownership of customer queries and working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver excellent service. Key Responsibilities - Handle customer enquiries via phone, email and live chat. - Provide clear and accurate information regarding products and services. - Resolve customer issues efficiently, escalating complex cases when required. - Work closely with internal teams and external suppliers to resolve service-related queries. - Maintain accurate customer records and update internal systems. - Identify opportunities to promote additional products and services where appropriate. - Manage your workload effectively to meet service and performance targets. - Deliver a consistently high standard of customer care and professionalism. About You We're keen to speak with individuals who can demonstrate: - Previous customer service or customer-facing experience. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. - A positive, professional and customer-focused approach. - Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. - The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. - Confidence working both independently and as part of a team. - Competent IT skills, including experience using computer-based systems. - A resilient and adaptable approach when managing customer enquiries. What's on Offer? - Competitive salary. - 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. - Employer pension contribution. - Healthcare plan. - Employee Assistance Programme with 24-hour GP access. - Group Income Protection. - Ongoing training and development opportunities. - Structured career progression pathways. - A collaborative and supportive working environment. - Regular company social events. Apply Now If you're passionate about providing exceptional customer service and are looking to join an organisation that genuinely invests in its people, we'd love to hear from you.
